news.title: Suncity Synthetics Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 30 million in funding
news.body: SUNCITY SYNTHETICS LIMITED announced a private placement to issue 3,000,000 shares at an issue price of INR 10 per share for gross proceeds of INR 30,000,000 on March 20, 2026. The transaction will include participation from new investors Sumita Mishra Bharat Kumar Mardia and other investors. The transaction has been approved by shareholders and is subject to general shareholders and is subject to general shareholders to be held on March 30, 2026.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.15 (vs ₹0.22 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.15 (down from ₹0.22 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹2.18m (up 9.2% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹769.0k (down 31% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 35% (down from 56% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 43% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 39% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.6% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (8.6% average weekly change). Negative equity (-₹4.6m). Revenue is less than US$1m (₹4.1m revenue, or US$45k). Market cap
